query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM actors a WHERE a.canonical_identity=? AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM read_marks m WHERE m.reader_actor=a.actor_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_watches w WHERE w.reader_actor=a.actor_id AND w.active=1) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM thread_watches w WHERE w.reader_actor=a.actor_id AND w.active=1))) AS "present!: i64"
